name: Pixel IC Support (BeagleBone)
author: joeskolengaden
description: Adds about 40 more pixel ICs to FPP on a BeagleBone: PRU timing presets (APA104, TM1814/TM1829/TM1914, WS2805, UCS7604, TM1903, UCS2912, TX1812 and more), a Custom timing mode for any other single-wire chip, 16-bit and 5/6-channel orders, chip-current controls and a per-port pixel-limit panel. Includes the SPIPixels clocked-chip library.

privacy.summary: Patches FPP's BeagleBone pixel driver and pixel-strings page to support more chips, and rebuilds two FPP libraries on install. It sends nothing off the device.

systemChanges.what: patches FPP's BBB48String driver, PRU source, PixelString and pixel-strings page; rebuilds libfpp.so
adds a temporary swap file while compiling (removed afterwards); Uninstall restores the .orig backups

privacy.other: The installer stops fppd for a few minutes while it recompiles, then restarts it.
